name: Ballad of the Cosplayer
source:
After entering a cosplay contest finale, you thought all you needed to do was strike a cool pose and leave with the winnings-- only during that final moment you're transported to another world! 

Now under the guise of being the summoned "Demon King" you must convince the  monsters around you that you're in fact one of them. 

Not to mention a "hero" and almost-literal god are out for your neck! Will you survive and possibly find romance or die trying?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250828175906/https://futotori.itch.io/ballad-of-the-cosplayer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
进入角色扮演比赛决赛后，你以为你所需要做的就是摆出一个很酷的姿势并带着奖金离开——只是在最后一刻你被传送到了另一个世界！

现在，在被召唤的“恶魔之王”的幌子下，你必须让周围的怪物相信你实际上是他们中的一员。

更不用说“英雄”和几乎名副其实的上帝正在对你的脖子进行攻击！你会生存下来并可能找到浪漫，还是会在尝试中死去？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250828175906/https://futotori.itch.io/ballad-of-the-cosplayer]itch.io[/url]]
